executive_brief: This project establishes the technical governance and quality standards for an e-commerce article management system. It focuses on defining the development constitution, coding standards, and branching workflows to ensure architectural consistency across the platform's lifecycle.

architectural_constraints: Adherence to defined Coding Standards & Style
Strict compliance with the Branching & PR Workflow

maturity_assessment: The specifications provide a foundational governance framework but lack concrete implementation details, tool configurations, and automated testing gates. Despite the high parser health index, the absence of technical nodes indicates a purely constitutional state. The project is READY for the initial setup phase, provided that the specific technology stack is defined during execution.
critical_dependencies: Definition of the specific runtime environment
Establishment of the CI/CD pipeline to enforce the PR Workflow
Configuration of the version control system according to the branching strategy
